title: The St. Vrain

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: The St Vrain is a uniquely iconic events venue in the heart of historic downtown Longmont, Colorado. Strategically located between Boulder and Denver, our space offers a warm and inviting urban chic vibe and flexible spaces for both intimate and large gatherings from 60 to 250 guests. If you’d like more information on how we can make your corporate events, team gatherings, offsites, and business meetings in Longmont one of a kind, we’d be happy to schedule a virtual or in-person meeting with you to discuss the details.
